How much of QN12 is paved and how much is green?
An experimental satellite land-cover model answers, labelled as a proxy, with its agreement against ESA WorldCover and its own noise.

From an experimental model, not a measurement: Experimental: a satellite land-cover model labels 91.9% of this area as paved or built over and 7.9% as trees or grass, on Sentinel-2 scenes from 2026; in 2018 the paved or built share was 89.4%, a difference of 2.5 points, inside the 3.7 points by which two images of one year can differ, so no change is measurable and no trend in runoff follows from it.
What did satellite imagery show in BK18 after Ida?
What an experimental satellite model showed after Hurricane Ida, with the plain statement that it did no better than chance against surveyed flood marks.

From an experimental model, not a measurement: Experimental: a satellite model on Sentinel-2 scenes from 2021-09-02, the day after Hurricane Ida, compared with 2021-08-13, showed 1,100 m² of new surface water in this area (98% of it observed); of 10 other heavy-rain events since 2017 with a clear pass over this place, it showed new water after 6 (2017-10-29, 2023-09-11, 2023-11-22, 2024-03-23, 2025-03-05, 2026-08-03).
